findings: Phase 1 (hashed-bow embedder): note-level recall@5 flat at 0.875 across chunk_size 150/300/500, overlap 0/80, embed_context_header on/off, skip_headings on/off; the fake-embedding metric is robust to chunking, size/latency carried all signal.

Phase 2 (real nomic-embed-text + Qdrant): winner = chunk_size=500, overlap=80, embed_context_header=true, skip_headings=['🔗 Related Notes'] — recall equal to baseline at every k with 23% fewer chunks and ~16% faster sync.

chunk_size=150 confirmed harmful on real embeddings: recall@3 dropped 0.875 -> 0.792 and MRR 0.875 -> 0.864 despite phase-1 neutrality — cheap fake-embedding sweeps can hide semantic dilution effects; confirm winners on the real stack.

chunk_size is measured in WORDS and sections shorter than the window chunk one-per-section: on short-section vaults the knob is a no-op between 150-800; overlap likewise only engages when a section exceeds the window.
embed_context_header=true vs false: no measurable recall difference on either embedder; keep default true.
Vacuous probes are a hazard: overlap=0 at size 500 and size 300/800 on short sections produce identical indexes; sweep design must check chunk_count actually changed before trusting a flat metric.

Round 2: embed_context_header=false + skip_headings reaches recall@5=1.0 on real nomic-embed-text (stable re-runs) vs 0.875 for the round-1 champion — the context header HURTS deep recall on real embeddings (title tokens dilute section vectors), though recall@3 drops 0.875 -> 0.792.

Round 2: with header=false+skip, chunk sizes 250-800 all saturate recall@5=1.0 on real embeddings and differ only in chunk count (82-84); 150 needs 90 chunks for no recall gain. Size is an index-size choice in this band, not a recall lever.

Round 2 protocol deviation (documented): keep/discard decided on the real Ollama stack because the phase-1 hashed-bow metric is provably insensitive (flat 0.875 across every knob); each round-2 probe was measured on both embedders.
